item.title: China dominating accelerated global wind energy growth
item.description: New figures from the Global Wind Energy Council (GWEC) show 2025’s record new capacity installed was driven by accelerated growth across Asia. item.title: Great Lakes Pilotage Authority – Head Office Relocation
item.description: The Great Lakes Pilotage Authority (GLPA) hereby advises industry stakeholders that its Cornwall Head Office will relocate effective March 2, 2026. item.title: Port of Trois-Rivières reports 2.6MT of cargo handled in 2025
item.description: In 2025, the Port of Trois-Rivières handled 2.6 million metric tonnes (MMT) of cargo, supporting both regional and international trade flows. Traffic consisted of 1.9 MMT of dry bulk, 198,200 tonnes of liquid bulk, and 485,000 tonnes of general cargo. item.title: Global treaty on fishing vessel safety to enter into force in 2027
item.description: The 2012 Cape Town Agreement has met the requirements for entry into force and will enter into force in February 2027, closing a longstanding gap in the global maritime safety framework. Argentina’s accession triggered its entry into force in 12 months. item.description: The Port of Halifax has released annual statistics which show a 10.4% decline in total traffic and a marginal drop in container cargo in 2025.
